text:
sam: Heads-up: user reports and telemetry show a rise in tokenization failures from llm-proxy after yesterday's quant-path change. Errors primarily 502s when proxying long-context requests. Prepared v0.9.2-hotfix to short-circuit to safe execution path. Need fast approval to push during midday window.
tess: Do we have metrics on impact? SLA exposure?
sam: ~3% of requests failing in ap-south, small but noisy for paid customers. p50/p95 latency up ~30ms. SLA margin still ok but trending. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/llm-proxy/errors
hao: What's the change in v0.9.2-hotfix? Can we canary?
sam: It's a fallback to the non-quantized codepath for calls >8k tokens + guard for null attention mask. Single-file patch. Canary safe: route 4% traffic in ap-south only. Rollback is immediate to v0.9.1 image.
chris: Oncall, expedited flow?
sre-oncall: Weekday midday. We allow expedited with 2 engineer approvals + SRE. Canary mandatory for runtime-affecting changes. Also require an explicit post-deploy alert that pages on regressions.
tess: I'll +1 if we pin canary to ap-south only and add page conditions. Define rollback criteria (502s >0.7% absolute increase or p95 >400ms for 5m).
sam: Agreed. Rollback command: `kubectl set image deploy/llm-proxy llm-proxy=redwood/llm-proxy:v0.9.1 --namespace=ap-south` and `deployctl rollback --service llm-proxy --to v0.9.1`. I'll run if triggers.
hao: +1 from me. I will watch traces and sampling logs.
sre-oncall: +1 from SRE. I've created fast alert: `llm-proxy-ap-south-regress` -> page SRE if thresholds hit.
sam: /deploy start ap-south llm-proxy v0.9.2-hotfix --canary=4 --note "fallback for quant-path tokenization regressions"
deploy-bot: Deploy request accepted: ap-south/llm-proxy -> v0.9.2-hotfix. Canary 4% (2 pods). Starting rollout.
deploy-bot: Canary pods launching: llm-proxy-v0.9.2-rc-1 (9s), llm-proxy-v0.9.2-rc-2 (11s). Healthchecks and trace-sampler enabled.
hao: Kicking off trace sampling query for 10 recent failed requests.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics (1m): 502 rate 0.05% (baseline 0.9%), p95 120ms (baseline 95ms). No new errors observed.
sre-oncall: Canary looks stable. Alerting configured. Authorizing staged rollout to 30% with 5m watch then 100% if green.
sam: /deploy promote ap-south llm-proxy v0.9.2-hotfix --to=30 --reason "canary stable, SRE approved"
deploy-bot: Promotion started: shifting traffic to 30% target. Progress: 10% -> 30%. Checks passing.
deploy-bot: Metrics at 30% (3m): 502 rate 0.06%, p95 130ms. No page.
sam: Proceeding to 100% after 5m stable per plan.
deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% in progress: 60% -> 100%.
deploy-bot: Deployment complete: llm-proxy v0.9.2-hotfix now serving 100% in ap-south. Commit: https://deploys.redwood/commit/1a2b3c
hao: Running post-deploy smoke and trace verification. Sampling looks good.
sre-oncall: Observability hooks show no regression. I'll keep alert enabled and will escalate if anything pops.
tess: I'll draft release note: "v0.9.2-hotfix: Fallback to safe execution path for long-context quantized requests; guard for null attention masks."
sam: Thanks all. Monitoring for 45m, will roll back immediately if criteria breached.
chris: Nice work. Will mark tickets and update status page if we see any customer impact resolved.
sam: Closing thread unless SRE pages. :white_check_mark:
